verdict: On a measured lab pattern Concord ranks Pt3Co first (score 0.94) ahead of PtNi (0.665) and pure Pt (0.513, 0 reflections matched), indexing 4 of 5 peaks; the unindexed broad peak at 29.4 deg is most likely the rGO (002) support band. Sphere diameter 3.4 nm (Scherrer median 2.7 nm): nanocrystalline, as expected. Caveat: the L1_2 model predicts (100)/(110) superlattice lines that the data barely show, so ordering is not confirmed, only the Pt-Co fcc alloy.
